text: 1. SDUW Application Form for Admission to Chinese Language Program 2. Photocopy of passport, including the page of personal information and visa or residence permit. The passport should have a validity of at least 6 months. 3. High school diploma or above or equivalent. If the certificates are not available yet, a pregraduation certificate should be presented to affirm the applicant’s expected graduation date. 4. Official transcripts for all the courses in high-school or above studies 5. CV in Chinese, or English, or Korean 6. Foreigner Physical Examination Form Note: The physical examination form must be fully filled in. Incomplete forms or forms without the signature of the attending physician, or the official stamp of the hospital, or a stamped photograph will be deemed invalid. Please ensure your physical examination result remains valid during your application time as its validity is only 6 months. 7. Electronic Photos Note: The photo should be in the size of 33mm×48mm with white background in JPG format. Scanned copies of developed photos are not acceptable. Two developed photos should be submitted upon registration.
